meaning:
στρατολογέω, -ῶ
(στρατός, λέγω),
to levy a troop, enlist soldiers: 2Ti.2:4 (Diod., Plut., al.).†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: him who hath chosen him to be a soldier

elsewhere.note: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.
